meta.name: refactor
meta.description: Intelligent refactor command. Triggers: refactor, refactoring, cleanup, restructure, extract, simplify, modernize.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 重构代码结构，消除坏味道，提升可维护性
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果代码变得难以维护，需要系统性地改善结构
copy.tagline_en: Restructure code, eliminate bad smells, and improve maintainability
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your codebase has become hard to maintain and needs systematic structural improvement

howto.what: 装上后，当你要求重构代码时，Claude 会先分析你的意图和代码库，评估风险，然后逐步执行重构并持续验证，确保不破坏现有功能。
howto.when: 当你提到“重构”“清理”“简化”“现代化”等关键词，或要求整理代码时触发。

say.note: Claude 将分析该文件并执行安全重构。

say.text: 帮我提取验证逻辑到独立模块。
say.note: Claude 会按照指定模式进行结构拆分。

howto.what_en: After installation, when you ask to refactor code, Claude first analyzes your intent and codebase, assesses risk, then performs step-by-step refactoring with continuous verification to avoid breaking existing functionality.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention keywords like 'refactor', 'cleanup', 'simplify', 'modernize', or ask to restructure code.

say_en.note: Claude will analyze and safely refactor the file.

say_en.text: Extract validation logic into a separate module.
say_en.note: Claude will restructure per your description.
Claude will execute project-wide aggressive refactoring.
